facts.fact: The minister said the National Registration Act was undergoing amendment to introduce a population register for Botswana (Daily News/BOPA).

The National Registration (Amendment) Act 2025 (No. 7), assented 23 March 2025, provides for a Unified Population Register of all citizens, dual citizens and non-citizen residents kept by the registrar; commencement is on ministerial notice.
